_doc: Whole-tree checks ./publish runs before it pushes, and refuses on a red, naming the check and its fix. Owner by card 2026-11-12 ~8:25 PM PST (ledger 2026-11-13T04:34:04Z): Whole-tree checks -> 'Publish runs the fast ones and refuses on red'; validation_map_and_rules.md rule 10. They run in parallel. seconds = one run alone on archmagi 2026-11-12 (measured). A whole-tree check too slow for this list runs at the door only when its inputs change (pipeline_tests.json, any_change): the nightly checks finished mods only (nightly_scope.py), so a check left to the nightly runs nowhere. A publish whose local commits touch only skip_when_only paths runs nothing. A sparse clone runs them on a throwaway full checkout of HEAD (publish.py full_head_tree), so it needs no bypass. A one-off bypass: RM_PUBLISH_SKIP_TREE_CHECKS='<why>' (printed, never silent); a sparse clone is not a reason. Code: publish.py tree_checks().
_timeout_s: danger=a test in an endless loop holds a landing with no end; longest=599s (selftest_maturation_autonomy.py PASS at load 45, 2026-11-24). The backstop only: a check that does nothing ends on progress_guard.SILENCE_S. A check that is ended reads UNMEASURED and is not refused.

checks.fix: the proof or scene it names must put each settings or def write back to the PRIOR value on every exit path (a try whose finally writes it back); a reviewed exception carries `restore-check: ok <why>`; a leak you cannot fix now goes in BASELINE with its filed item. It scans the whole tree, so a leak in one mod turned ExplosiveKnockback's decider T_RESTORE red three times before it ran here
retire each DEAD stand-in it names: python3 src/RimMandrake/Utils/art/retire_orphan_art.py --item <ITEM> --apply <path>
run python3 src/RimMandrake/Utils/canonical_saves.py write and publish the generated file; when canon.yml names a new start, name it in the guard block of infrastructure/state/CANONICAL_SAVE.md first
never edit a mod ledger shard or view by hand: append with modledger.py append, then modledger.py views --mod <Mod>; run modledger.py lint --mod <Mod> to see the line
name the game ArchBig, ArchSmall, Steve1 or Steve2; an old key may stay only inside a `code span` (an alias) or an owner quote
say Conductor, or keep BENCH only on a held path or key (the test's ALLOWED)
drop the twin name from src/, or list the tool in TOOLS with why it reads the record

a REMNANT path: delete it (git is the archive) and add its Removed row to design/RimMandrake/retired_eras_index_2026-11-18.md, or allow it there under Phase 2 or Kept on purpose with a reason. An ERA TEXT line: say on that line that the thing is retired (or rewrite it to what runs today); a design doc, skill reference, lesson or fact may instead take the HISTORY head (python3 src/RimMandrake/Utils/era_history_mark.py --apply)
import the path from game_paths (LOCALLOW, PLAYER_LOG, MODS_CONFIG, DEF_DUMP)
write live_proofs lines as '<ID> <LEVEL>: ...' (no '- ' bullets); run the test to see the line
name the data root through rmpaths, never D:\Luke\dev\_<dir>
a new root namespace of ours goes in launch_gate.OWN_NAMESPACES; an engine fake lives under tests/, Scenario/ or a selftest folder
never hand-edit FaunaNorm_* patches: change fauna_normalization.py and regenerate its outputs
reorder infrastructure/state/modlists/ModsConfig.FULL.LATEST.xml so every About loadAfter/loadBefore edge holds
write RUT_Umbra, or list a record file in HISTORIC with its reason
a baseline row that now passes leaves drawn_art_ruled_baseline.json; a new unruled drawing gets its ruling
a retired module leaves with its last reference; a moved doc is repointed in entrypoint_inventory.PROBES/KEPT

a new time budget in pipeline machinery: use time_budget.CALL_S, or add `# budget: danger=...; evidence=...; longest=<N>s (<record>, or one measured run)` beside the number, at 10 times the longest run or more; or guard on progress (progress_guard.py)
pass timeout= to the subprocess call the lint names

a counter of bad outcomes that stops or escalates asks failure_class (src/RimMandrake/rimflow/failure_class.py) which outcomes count; when none of its outcomes is the work's, list it with its reason in src/RimMandrake/Utils/failure_counter_list.json

a NEW could-not-look place in pipeline code: return probe_result.could_not_look(cause) (or raise) instead of an empty value; or, when only a rare failure reaches it, add it to could_not_look_allowlist.json places with its line under reasons (RARE (<page> <entry>): why, listed on the module's boundary page as not handled, or NOT A COLLAPSE: why)
update design/RimMandrake/alpha_biomes_census_2026-11-01.json (port targets, tokens), then alpha_biomes_census.py md

an oversized live test (over one game day, the full list, or several claims) with no cheaper_why: write the cheaper scene, or say in cheaper_why of its test-table entry why a cheaper test cannot decide the bar; see python3 src/RimMandrake/rimflow/scene_size.py check
a pilot or fixer writes its evidence inside the open visit's folder (version/in_game/visit_<record's visit>/<what>/); only the Stage 6 driver opens a new visit_N
roles/designer.md quotes the first-version sections of roles/designer_cleanse.md word for word: change both copies or neither
move the static it names to a Map/GameComponent or guard it on Current.Game; or, after reading the code, list it in REVIEWED with why it is safe across a game reload
put the setting it names in exactly one Section(...) name array of its mod's settings screen, so Reset and search reach it
